# Palo Alto Extraction Remediation Plan

This implementation plan covers the complete remediation of the Palo Alto source parser to use the canonical `ExtractionResult` accounting rather than best-effort "XML -> IR". It enforces the "zero silent loss" principle and addresses known unsafe semantic fallback behaviors.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **FINAL / FROZEN REVISION**
> This document incorporates all architectural corrections and final clarifications. Please approve to commence implementation.

## Proposed Changes

The work will be executed in the following 20 distinct phases exactly as specified.

---

### Phase 0: Safety regression tests
Preserve currently correct Palo Alto behavior with regression tests. Add failing characterization/safety tests for known incorrect behavior. Never encode unsafe current behavior (such as missing action -> `allow`) as the expected result. Add separate test cases for malformed XML (parse/input error), valid XML + unsupported field (`UNSUPPORTED`/`EXTRACT_ONLY`), and valid XML + malformed supported value (`PARSE_ERROR`).

---

### Phase 1: ExtractionResult + source context foundation
Introduce `ExtractionResult` context and source tracking. Explicitly reuse the generic `from fwmigrate.extraction.models import ExtractionResult` without creating a PAN-specific class. Constrain raw XML retention: prefer `source_path` + structured attributes + sanitized excerpt. Ensure secrets are redacted and captures are bounded.
Ensure the `extract(...) -> ExtractionResult` and `parse(...) -> IRConfig` compatibility contract is respected.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)
#### [NEW] [extraction.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/extraction.py)
#### [NEW] [source_model.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/source_model.py)
#### [NEW] [xml_utils.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/xml_utils.py)

---

### Phase 2: Unsafe defaults + IR default audit
Fix P0 broadening behavior (`any`, `allow`, `0.0.0.0/0`, `interface`). Explicitly distinguish three states for fields (especially `log-start`, `log-end`, `disabled`, `metric`, `service`): A) explicitly configured, B) absent from source, C) effective PAN-OS default.
Audit and override Pydantic IR defaults so the parser doesn't accidentally invent semantics. Update `validators.py` to ensure empty semantics are not re-interpreted. Scan target generators and fix only those that broaden empty fields.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)
#### [MODIFY] [validators.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/validation/validators.py)

---

### Phase 3: Scoped traversal + resolver
Implement traversal for first-VSYS-only parsing and namespace collisions. Explicitly define a `ScopedKey(scope_kind, scope_name, object_type, source_name)`. Track canonical name, source name, and scoped key independently.
Define deterministic lookup order (VSYS: local -> shared -> predefined; Panorama: current DG -> parent DGs -> shared -> predefined).
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

---

### Phase 4: Interfaces + zones
Extract real network topology. Explicitly separate interface definitions from zone references (a zone referencing an interface doesn't mean the interface was configured; retain unresolved interface references without inventing IR). Keep PAN zone type separate from generic interface types.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

---

### Phase 5: Objects/services/schedules/apps
Extract objects and groups. Application work is extraction/inventory-first. Complex schedules must not be truncated; port what fits to IR, preserve the rest in extraction inventory as `PARTIALLY_NORMALIZED`.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

---

### Phase 6: Security policies/profiles/default rules
Extract policies with absolute fidelity. Preserve rule order as data (`source_rule_index`, `rulebase_position`, `scope`). For Panorama, this means `pre`/`local`/`post`. Do not calculate effective merged policy order yet.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

---

### Phase 7: NAT rewrite
Introduce intermediate models (`PANSourceTranslation`, `PANDestinationTranslation`) before canonical mapping. NAT parsing order must be strictly defined: 1. match, 2. source trans, 3. dest trans, 4. dynamic dest trans, 5. determine state, 6. construct IR, 7. classify status.
NAT rules without SNAT/DNAT are not errors—preserve and classify them.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)
#### [NEW] [nat.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/nat.py)

---

### Phase 8: IPv4/IPv6 routing
Split IPv4 and IPv6 routing. Do not create invalid canonical routes just to satisfy IR validation (no invented `0.0.0.0/0`). Retain absent required fields as `PARSE_ERROR`/`PARTIALLY_NORMALIZED`.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)
#### [NEW] [routing.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/routing.py)

---

### Phase 9: Panorama hierarchy
This phase extracts configured Panorama hierarchy. It does not claim to calculate the final effective policy produced by device-group inheritance, overrides, templates, or deployment processing.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)
#### [NEW] [panorama.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/panorama.py)

---

### Phase 10: Residual/source accounting
Use discovery/accounting rather than just a hard-coded list. Discover migration-relevant subtrees, dispatch handlers, and account for unhandled subtrees (classified strictly as `EXTRACT_ONLY`, `VENDOR_EXTENSION`, `UNSUPPORTED`, or `PARSE_ERROR`).
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)
#### [NEW] [residual.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/residual.py)

---

### Phase 11: Excel integration
Implement a generic `Source Inventory` worksheet with columns: Vendor, Domain, Scope Type, Scope Name, Source Path, Object Name, Setting, Value, Extraction Status, Manual Review, Notes.
#### [MODIFY] [excel_exporter.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/report/excel_exporter.py)

---

### Phase 12: Parser abstraction + web/CLI
Define a base parser fallback contract: `BaseSourceParser` implements `extract(...) -> ExtractionResult` that wraps `parse(...)`. Update orchestration to consume `ExtractionResult`.
#### [MODIFY] [web.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/web.py)
#### [MODIFY] [main.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/main.py)
#### [MODIFY] `src/fwmigrate/parsers/base.py` (add fallback `extract()` method)

---

### Phase 13: Input format detection
XML sniffing must identify PAN XML (not just generic XML). Valid unrelated XML or arbitrary text raises an unsupported input format error. Malformed PAN XML raises parse/input error. PAN set CLI raises unsupported input format.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

---

### Phase 14: Scope-aware dependency validation
Define PAN builtin/predefined namespaces (`PAN_BUILTIN_TOKENS`, `PAN_PREDEFINED_SERVICES`, etc.) so they participate in scope-aware resolution without being mistaken for locally defined objects.
#### [MODIFY] [validators.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/validation/validators.py)

---

### Phase 15: Documentation
#### [MODIFY] [IR_DATA_STRUCTURE.md](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/documentation/IR_DATA_STRUCTURE.md)
#### [MODIFY] [EXTRACTION_DATA_MODEL.md](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/documentation/EXTRACTION_DATA_MODEL.md)

---

### Phase 16: Fixtures
Add the necessary focused XML fixtures to `tests/fixtures/palo_alto/`.

---

### Phase 17: Focused PAN regression
Run tests targeting only the changed PAN-OS components to ensure the semantic matrix is fully covered.

---

### Phase 18: Full regression + workbook inspection
Ensure the entire repository's test suite remains green. Manually inspect Excel output.

---

### Phase 19: Final zero-silent-loss audit
Strengthen the accounting invariant to exactly-once classification. For every migration-relevant discovered source record, exactly one terminal `ExtractionStatus` must be assigned. Assert no duplicate accounting, no unclassified source records, and no count mismatch.
```text
source_count = normalized_count + partially_normalized_count + extract_only_count + vendor_extension_count + unsupported_count + ignored_by_policy_count + parse_error_count
```

## Verification Plan

### Final Verification Gates
DONE only when:
1. Palo semantic regression matrix passes.
2. Full repository pytest passes.
3. Extraction accounting balances exactly with no duplicate/unclassified records.
4. Generated workbook manual inspection confirms no known migration-relevant PAN source configuration silently disappears.
